trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document), (p)-[r:PlaysFor]->(t:Team) WHERE r.tenure = 'latest' AND (((t.team_name <> 'Houston Rockets') AND CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) > 2) OR (t.founded_year <> '1949' AND t.championships <> '1')) RETURN p.position AS col1, SUM(CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64)) AS col2
